methods.name: Apply
methods.description:
Create or update a workflow.
 The authorization and state-operation are determined depending on whether the workflow
 is going to be created or updated which is determined as part of the request execution.

methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Create a new workflow.

 Authorization:
 - Organization-scoped workflows: Caller must have can_create_workflow permission in the organization
 - Platform-scoped workflows: Caller must be a platform operator (handled automatically by common auth step)

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Get a single workflow by ID.

methods.name: GetByReference

methodTypes.name: ApiResourceReference
methodTypes.description:
Generic reference to any API resource by org and slug.
 Used across resources to reference other resources (e.g., Environment, Agent, Skill).
 Canonical format: "org/slug" (e.g., "stigmer/web-search", "acme/my-agent").

fields.name: Org
fields.description:
Organization that owns the referenced resource.

 When non-empty: must be a valid org slug (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens,
 starts with a letter, 1-63 characters). Example: "stigmer", "acme-corp".

 When empty: the reference is relative — the server resolves it to the parent
 resource's organization at write time. All stored and returned references
 always have org populated (absolute form).

 Use empty org for same-org references (the common case).
 Use explicit org for cross-org references (e.g., marketplace resources).

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: Kind of the referenced resource (e.g., SKILL, AGENT, MCP_SERVER).

fields.name: Slug
fields.description:
Resource slug (user-friendly identifier, unique within org).
 Format: lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens, must start with a letter (e.g., "web-search", "code-reviewer").
 Length: 1-63 characters.

fields.name: Version
fields.description:
Version of the resource (optional, only applicable to versioned resources like Skills).
 Supports three formats:
 1. Empty/unset → Resolves to "latest" (most recent version)
 2. Tag name → Resolves to version with this tag (e.g., "stable", "v1.0")
 3. Exact hash → Immutable reference to specific version (e.g., "abc123...")

 Default behavior: Empty means "latest" (current version).
 This field is ignored for non-versioned resources.

 Examples:
 - version: ""           → Use latest version
 - version: "latest"     → Use latest version (explicit)
 - version: "stable"     → Use version tagged as "stable"
 - version: "v1.0"       → Use version tagged as "v1.0"
 - version: "abc123..."  → Use exact version with this hash (immutable)

resourceDescription: Workflow represents a workflow orchestration definition.

statusType.name: WorkflowStatus
statusType.description: WorkflowStatus contains system-managed state for a Workflow resource.

fields.name: Audit
fields.description: Standard audit information (created_at, updated_at, created_by, etc.)

fields.name: DefaultInstanceId
fields.description:
ID of the default workflow instance created automatically for this workflow.
 Every workflow has exactly one default instance that requires no configuration.
 This instance has no environment bindings and uses all workflow defaults.
 Created automatically when the workflow is created.

fields.name: ServerlessWorkflowValidation
fields.description:
Serverless Workflow YAML generation and validation state.
 Populated asynchronously after workflow creation via Temporal workflow.
 Contains the generated CNCF Serverless Workflow DSL 1.0.0 YAML and validation results.

 Workflow creation does NOT block on validation - the workflow is created immediately
 with status.state = PENDING, then validation runs in the background.

 Users can check this field to see if their workflow is valid before executing it.

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAudit
statusNestedTypes.description: ApiResourceAudit contains both spec-level and status-level audit details.

fields.name: SpecAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's specification (desired state).

fields.name: StatusAudit
fields.description: Audit info for the resource's status (actual state).

fields.name: CreatedBy
fields.description: Actor who created this resource.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was created.

fields.name: UpdatedBy
fields.description: Actor who last updated this resource.

fields.name: UpdatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the resource was last updated.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: Type of the last event (e.g., "created", "updated").

statusNestedTypes.name: ApiResourceAuditActor
statusNestedTypes.description: ApiResourceAuditActor represents the entity that performed an action.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the actor.

fields.name: Avatar
fields.description: URL to the actor's avatar image.

statusNestedTypes.name: ServerlessWorkflowValidation
statusNestedTypes.description:
ServerlessWorkflowValidation contains the generated Serverless Workflow YAML
 and its validation state. This is populated asynchronously after workflow creation
 via a Temporal workflow that validates the workflow structure.

fields.name: State
fields.description: Current validation state

fields.name: Yaml
fields.description:
Generated Serverless Workflow YAML (CNCF DSL 1.0.0 format)
 This YAML may contain runtime expressions for environment variables:
   Example: ${ .env.API_BASE_URL }

 Present even if validation failed (helps debugging).
 Empty if validation hasn't started yet.

fields.name: Errors
fields.description:
Validation errors (empty if valid)
 Examples:
   - "Invalid YAML syntax at line 15"
   - "Unknown task type 'invalid_task'"
   - "Missing required field: document.namespace"

fields.name: Warnings
fields.description:
Non-fatal warnings
 Examples:
   - "Environment variable API_KEY referenced but not defined"
   - "Task 'fetchData' has no error handling"

fields.name: ValidatedAt
fields.description:
When validation was performed
 Null if validation hasn't completed yet

fields.name: ValidationWorkflowId
fields.description:
Temporal workflow ID for the validation workflow
 Format: "validate-workflow-{workflow_id}"
 Useful for tracking/debugging validation progress
